newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goodman Fielder sells starch business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goodman Fielder sells starch business.

text.p: Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Monday its European foods group Meneba NV has sold the trading assets of a starch business for A$28 million.

Goodman Fielder chief executive David Hearn said the assets of the small Latenstein Zetmeet BV business had been bought by AVEBE b.a, a large Dutch co-operative producer whose principle business is starch.

The decision to sell followed a review of all group businesses, Hearn said. "Our Dutch starch business was only a small part of our European foods group and the return on assets was relatively low," he said.
"The Latenstein business was not providing shareholders with an adequate return and its sale provided us with an opportunity to redeem some of our Dutch Guilder debt."
The Latenstein business had sales of A$72.8 million in 1995/96, which represents about six percent of total sales by Goodman's European food group, Hearn said.
Other group businesses include Meneba Meel BV, a flour milling business, Quality Bakers RV, a baking business, and Koudijs-Wouda Voeders BV, a stock feed business.
Goodman Fielder said last month its European business would struggle to match its 1995/96 results due to aggressive bakeries competition and higher European wheat costs.
